title: Rust: owned grants and receive interval state
description:
Extend rust/lichen-node/src/tdma_scheduler.rs and rust/lichen-link/src/tdma_clock.rs beyond candidate and slot-membership helpers. Maintain bounded owner-qualified TX grants and receiver commitments, requiring matching physical channel/profile and validity. Prevent overlapping half-duplex obligations and prevent high-priority queued TX from preempting an established receive interval.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse b7z9.22 mechanics and the existing writer/slot_map_tx_allowed helpers, including oamc's closed helper baseline. The new leaf is remaining CCP2 ownership/integration, not another helper port or a dependency on the legacy parent. Keep fixed memory bounds, existing queue deadlines/priorities and best-effort custody. No per-packet reservation protocol, universal ACK, new dependency or identity/security redesign belongs here.
acceptance_criteria: Drive production interval eligibility with vectors.04/.08 independent event traces. Test anonymous slot maps, wrong owner, sender grant without receiver RX, receiver TX/RX overlap, expired assignments, queued SOS during RX, zero slots and equal modulo-eight hash residues through SFN wrap. Confirm only specified assignments/collision repair establish exclusivity. Extend rust/lichen-node/tests/ccp_slot_map_validation.rs and rust/lichen-link/tests/tdma_clock_vectors.rs with revision-specific cases; run tests, no_std checks, fmt and clippy.
